hi_1: Hi, I'm Marina, an animation director from Kyiv
p_desc: Thanks to animation, you can enter your own world and invite your friends to join you!
child: Since childhood, I’ve immersed myself in the world of creativity — filming short movies, learning editing, drawing, building sets, and doing crafts. Over time, this passion led me to animation. Music, especially its deep and meaningful fragments, evoked strong emotions in me — those emotions often became the foundation for my future stories.
university: I enrolled at the Ivan Karpenko-Kary National University of Theatre, Cinema and Television in Kyiv, majoring in animated film directing. There, I created my first original animated short films.
coop: Currently, I focus primarily on producing animated music videos, but I also work on animations for theater productions, poetry, animated series, and other creative formats. I’m open to collaboration and new ideas.
